name: Happy Birthday to You — with its pickup
source: the tune as it is usually printed, starting on beat 3

transcription.notes: The pickup is a leading rest of a half note, then a dotted eighth and a sixteenth on beat 3, so every bar is 96 units and the last bar keeps only its half note. Compare happy-birthday-melody.music.json, which starts on beat 1 with two eighths.
